description: JavaScript code implementing a countdown timer with start, pause, and stop controls, updating display elements, and handling keyboard events.

methods.name: updateDisplay
methods.description: Updates the timer display for hours, minutes, or seconds with proper formatting.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts the countdown timer, disables inputs, and updates display every second.

methods.name: pauseTimer
methods.description: Pauses the countdown timer by clearing intervals and toggling control states.

methods.name: stopTimer
methods.description: Stops and resets the timer, re-enabling inputs and resetting display.
